phrases.text: What do you like to do in your free time?

translations.es: ¿Qué te gusta hacer en tu tiempo libre?
translations.ar: ماذا تحب أن تفعل في وقت فراغك؟
translations.pt: O que você gosta de fazer no seu tempo livre?
translations.fr: Qu'aimez-vous faire pendant votre temps libre ?
translations.de: Was machst du gerne in deiner Freizeit?
translations.it: Cosa ti piace fare nel tuo tempo libero?
translations.en: What do you like to do in your free time?

phrases.text: Would you like to hang out this weekend?

translations.es: ¿Te gustaría salir a pasar el rato este fin de semana?
translations.ar: هل تود الخروج معاً نهاية هذا الأسبوع؟
translations.pt: Você gostaria de sair neste fim de semana?
translations.de: Möchtest du dieses Wochenende etwas unternehmen?
translations.it: Ti andrebbe di uscire questo fine settimana?
translations.en: Would you like to hang out this weekend?

phrases.text: Let's keep in touch and chat soon.

translations.es: Mantengamos el contacto y hablemos pronto.
translations.pt: Vamos manter contato e conversar em breve.
translations.fr: Gardons le contact et discutons bientôt.
translations.de: Lassen Sie uns in Kontakt bleiben und bald sprechen.
translations.it: Teniamoci in contatto e sentiamoci presto.
translations.en: Let's keep in touch and chat soon.

phrases.text: I really enjoy spending time with you.

translations.ar: أنا حقاً أستمتع بقضاء الوقت معك.
translations.pt: Eu realmente gosto de passar o tempo com você.
translations.fr: J'apprécie vraiment de passer du temps avec toi.
translations.de: Ich genieße es wirklich, Zeit mit dir zu verbringen.
translations.it: Mi piace davvero passare il tempo con te.
translations.en: I really enjoy spending time with you.

phrases.text: Tell me more about your hobbies.

translations.pt: Conte-me mais sobre os seus hobbies.
translations.fr: Parle-moi un peu plus de tes loisirs.
translations.de: Erzählen Sie mir mehr über Ihre Hobbies.
translations.it: Raccontami di più sui tuoi hobby.
translations.en: Tell me more about your hobbies.

phrases.text: That sounds like a great idea.

translations.es: Eso suena como una gran idea.
translations.fr: Ça a l'air d'être une excellente idée.
translations.de: Das hört sich nach einer tollen Idee an.
translations.en: That sounds like a great idea.

phrases.text: It was great talking to you.

translations.fr: C'était super de discuter avec toi.
translations.de: Es war toll, mit dir zu sprechen.
translations.it: È stato bello parlare con te.
translations.en: It was great talking to you.
